item.title: [SwiftHFR] Legacy reference 2440d79 is 44 commits behind legacy master: later features are missing from parity (M4)

labels.name: status: claimed
labels.description: A session has claimed it (/claim comment); see the claim rules in AGENTS.md

labels.name: beta-test finding
labels.description: Reported during pre-beta or beta testing on a device; counted for stats

item.body:
### Summary
The legacy reference for parity is `2440d79` (2026-05-30), but legacy `master` is at `21173e77` (2026-10-27): 44 commits later. Features the operator uses daily exist only after `2440d79`, so parity checks and lot specs miss them (found on #653 and #654, 2026-11-08).

### Evidence
- The reply formatting bar (`Aa`) and the floating "+" button with its **Bouton +** setting are on `master`, absent at `2440d79` (#653, #654).
- AGENTS.md §2 and §4 tell every lot to cite `2440d79`.

### Legacy commits after 2440d79 that touch the app (35, release-prep and Dependabot commits left out)
- `9f15513d` 2026-09-30 Add default browser and SVG photo support
- `c7693a88` 2026-09-29 Improve composer, polls, and cached page management
- `f917fafd` 2026-09-20 Restore dark theme brightness control
- `d645f525` 2026-09-06 Corrige l'affichage mobile et désactive les vidéos intégrées

- `ae196aa0` 2026-08-07 Improve topic loading feedback and timeouts

- `3f9a6835` 2026-06-15 Fix anchored topic refresh restoration
- `602b900e` 2026-06-13 Refine stacked topic navigation indicator
- `138fb986` 2026-06-13 Add startup tab setting and preserve iPad sidebar state
- `1b9affa9` 2026-06-13 Harmonize topic bottom bar icons
- `6c0c23f3` 2026-06-12 Fix clipboard URL insertion in composer
- `7844a011` 2026-06-12 Fix composer editing and bottom bar usability
- `a9a449e9` 2026-06-11 Finalize message navigation fixes
- `527fc606` 2026-06-10 Fix moderation alert form submission
- `abaada6e` 2026-06-10 Fix quality alert topic routing
- `68f7cf0d` 2026-06-10 Fix reply return position and back swipe conflict
- `afec5433` 2026-06-10 Enable iPad multi-window support
- `ba422216` 2026-06-08 Fix third-party reply keyboard

### Decision needed (operator)
1. Move the reference to `21173e77` (or a later tag) for new specs, keeping old citations valid; or keep `2440d79` and port the later features as named items.
2. Who sweeps the list above against LOTS.md and the GAP table, to open what is missing.

### Acceptance criteria
- The decision is in an ADR or in AGENTS.md §2.
- Each commit above is mapped to a lot, a GAP row or an issue, or marked not wanted.

comments.body: Operator decision, 2026-11-08: the legacy parity reference moves to the current legacy, the version of the published iPhone Duo beta: **`legacy/duo-inner-cover` @ `2fe43da3`** (PR #372, still open, based on `master` `21173e77`). Citations at `2440d79` stay valid for what they cite; new specs and checks cite `2fe43da3` (or #372's merge commit once it lands). #450 (built on #372) is not the reference: its fate is a separate M4 decision, #659.

This issue stays open for the catch-up PR (specs, LOTS, GAP ledger).

Catch-up pass done in #686 (merged as e4a74ec9): specs, LOTS.md, lots.json, HFR-PROTOCOL timeouts, 21 GAP rows via the ledger (folded by the steward). New M4 issues #682-#685. #690 merged as 619214ee: LOT-147, LOT-146, LOT-100, LOT-101 and LOT-179 (sizes) in M4 as legacy-evolution backports; clearing split to LOT-187 (#689, M5). Follow-ups from the Fable review (non-blocking):
1. Ledger steward (#620): the GAP header should say when `port: legacy evolution (2fe43da3)` is used versus `port: ezzz Swift layer` on `a·master` rows.
2. LOT-187/LOT-179 specs: cite the APP_SWIFT proof that legacy's clear-cache entry is unreachable (`PlusSettingsViewController` only when `!HFRUsesNativeSwiftSettings()`, `APP_SWIFT=1` in every configuration).
3. #237's Summary and body still describe the FEAT-016 scope (tab rail when folded, `Closes #160`): edited once the operator confirms the LOT-147 scope reading (legacy at 2fe43da3 only, FEAT-016 extras stay on #160).
4. GAP-217: scroll position across fold/unfold is tracked nowhere explicitly (one line in LOT-147 "Not in this lot" or on #235).
